remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom rental in Stamford's desirable Cove neighborhood. This spacious, move-in-ready home offers a modern, updated feel throughout, featuring a stylish kitchen with contemporary finishes, sleek renovated bathrooms, updated flooring, and central A/C for year-round comfort. The well-designed layout provides plenty of space for everyday living while maintaining a fresh, clean look throughout. Ideally located just minutes from major transportation, shopping, restaurants, parks, beaches, and everything Stamford has to offer. Pet-friendly and available for immediate occupancy, this is a fantastic opportunity to enjoy a fully updated home in one of Stamford's most convenient neighborhoods. Schedule your showing today!
